_meta.what: Estimated stint-level rates for pre-1999 legacy entries (see tools/reference/estimated_stats_notes.md).
_meta.span: Each entry covers only the seasons listed in `seasons`, with that franchise, inside the entry's decade. 1990s entries stop at 1998: the 1999 season comes from nflverse and must be merged, not double-counted.

fields.sackPct: sacks/(attempts+sacks) %; sackPctConf low when any season predates official sacks (1982)
fields.certainty: author's own confidence in the underlying totals: high|med|low
